import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    
    static class ModInt {
        long v;
        
        ModInt() {
            this.v = 0;
        }
        
        ModInt(long _v) {
            this.v = norm(_v % MOD + MOD);
        }
        
        static long norm(long x) {
            return (x < MOD) ? x : x - MOD;
        }
        
        static ModInt make(long x) {
            ModInt m = new ModInt();
            m.v = x;
            return m;
        }
        
        ModInt add(ModInt b) {
            return make(norm(this.v + b.v));
        }
        
        ModInt sub(ModInt b) {
            return make(norm(this.v + MOD - b.v));
        }
        
        ModInt neg() {
            return make(norm(MOD - this.v));
        }
        
        ModInt mul(ModInt b) {
            return make((this.v * b.v) % MOD);
        }
        
        ModInt div(ModInt b) {
            return this.mul(b.inv());
        }
        
        ModInt addEq(ModInt b) {
            this.v = norm(this.v + b.v);
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt subEq(ModInt b) {
            this.v = norm(this.v + MOD - b.v);
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt mulEq(ModInt b) {
            this.v = (this.v * b.v) % MOD;
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt divEq(ModInt b) {
            this.v = this.mul(b.inv()).v;
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt inc() {
            this.v = norm(this.v + 1);
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt dec() {
            this.v = norm(this.v + MOD - 1);
            return this;
        }
        
        long extgcd(long a, long b, long[] xy) {
            long[] p = {a, 1, 0};
            long[] q = {b, 0, 1};
            while (q[0] != 0) {
                long t = p[0] / q[0];
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                    long tmp = p[i] - t * q[i];
                    p[i] = q[i];
                    q[i] = tmp;
                }
            }
            if (p[0] < 0) {
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                    p[i] = -p[i];
                }
            }
            xy[0] = p[1];
            xy[1] = p[2];
            return p[0];
        }
        
        ModInt inv() {
            long[] xy = new long[2];
            extgcd(this.v, MOD, xy);
            return make(norm(xy[0] + MOD));
        }
        
        ModInt pow(long p) {
            if (p < 0) {
                return inv().pow(-p);
            }
            ModInt a = new ModInt(1);
            ModInt x = new ModInt(this.v);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) {
                    a = a.mul(x);
                }
                x = x.mul(x);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return a;
        }
        
        boolean eq(ModInt b) {
            return this.v == b.v;
        }
        
        boolean neq(ModInt b) {
            return this.v != b.v;
        }
    }
    
    static class Bitset {
        long[] data;
        int size;
        
        Bitset(int n) {
            size = n;
            data = new long[(n + 63) / 64];
        }
        
        void set(int idx) {
            data[idx / 64] |= (1L << (idx % 64));
        }
        
        boolean get(int idx) {
            return (data[idx / 64] & (1L << (idx % 64))) != 0;
        }
        
        void clear() {
            Arrays.fill(data, 0);
        }
        
        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Arrays.hashCode(data);
        }
        
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object obj) {
            if (this == obj) return true;
            if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) return false;
            Bitset bitset = (Bitset) obj;
            return Arrays.equals(data, bitset.data);
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        int N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        ModInt[][] p = new ModInt[N][N];
        
        String[] line = br.readLine().split(" ");
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                long val = Long.parseLong(line[i * N + j]);
                p[i][j] = new ModInt(val);
                ModInt hundred = new ModInt(100);
                p[i][j] = p[i][j].div(hundred);
            }
        }
        
        Map<Bitset, ModInt> cur = new HashMap<>();
        Map<Bitset, ModInt> nxt = new HashMap<>();
        
        Bitset b = new Bitset(N);
        b.set(0);
        cur.put(b, new ModInt(1));
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (Map.Entry<Bitset, ModInt> entry : cur.entrySet()) {
                Bitset bs = entry.getKey();
                List<Integer> ones = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int idx = 0; idx < N; idx++) {
                    if (bs.get(idx)) {
                        ones.add(idx);
                    }
                }
                
                for (int e = 0; e < (1 << N); e++) {
                    ModInt pr = new ModInt(1);
                    for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                        if (((e >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                            pr = pr.mul(p[i][j]);
                        } else {
                            ModInt one = new ModInt(1);
                            ModInt sub = one.sub(p[i][j]);
                            pr = pr.mul(sub);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    Bitset nb = new Bitset(N);
                    for (int x : ones) {
                        for (int r = 0; r < N; r++) {
                            if ((((e >> r) & 1) == 1) && (((x >> r) & 1) == 0)) {
                                nb.set(x | (1 << r));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    
                    ModInt val = entry.getValue().mul(pr);
                    if (nxt.containsKey(nb)) {
                        nxt.put(nb, new ModInt(nxt.get(nb).v + val.v));
                    } else {
                        nxt.put(nb, val);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            cur.clear();
            cur.putAll(nxt);
            nxt.clear();
        }
        
        ModInt ans = new ModInt(0);
        Bitset full = new Bitset(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            full.set(i);
        }
        
        for (Map.Entry<Bitset, ModInt> entry : cur) {
            if (entry.getKey().get((1 << N) - 1)) {
                ans = new ModInt(ans.v + entry.getValue().v);
            }
        }
        
        pw.println(ans.v);
        pw.close();
    }
}
